description:
The Firmstrong Siren Lady 7-Speed, formerly known as the Chief Lady, is the ideal beach cruiser for women who want the classic look of a cruiser with the added performance of a multi-speed bicycle. Although the frame measures 17 inches, its extended length and 4-inch forward pedaling design make it a perfect fit for taller riders between 5 feet 4 inches and 6 feet 4 inches. However, because of the unique geometry, it remains an exceptionally comfortable choice for riders of all heights who value stability and a little something extra from their cruiser.

The standout feature of the Siren is the forward pedaling setup, where the pedals are shifted 4 inches in front of the rider's hips. In a traditional design, you push directly downward to pedal, but the Siren allows you to push slightly down and forward. This creates significant added leg room for taller women without needing to raise the seat to an uncomfortable height, providing full leg extension while keeping you lower to the ground. This laid-back riding position allows you to maintain a straight back while having your feet kicked forward, effectively taking the pressure off your hips and providing a greater sense of stability during your ride.

With the addition of a Shimano 7-speed gear system and front and rear handbrakes, the Siren Lady is much more versatile than a standard beach cruiser. These gears allow you to tackle hills and handle long-distance rides with ease, making it perfect for commuting or getting exercise. The frame design is clean and sleek, featuring a high-arched top tube that dips low to ensure getting on and off the bike is simple and safe. The Siren Lady 7-Speed is a long, elegant cruiser designed for women who want a high-performance ride that feels comfortable, stable, and feminine whether they are cruising the boardwalk or city streets.

17” Extended Length Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels and Painted Front/Rear Fenders

7 Speed Shimano External Gear Bicycle has a wide range of gears for all types of riding; short rides, long distance, and uphill riding

Great recreational riding bike for taller women or those who would like more leg and arm extension. 4” extended frame creates more space between rider and handlebars.

Step-through design allows riders to keep seat closer to ground while still getting proper leg extension

Frame Geometry makes riders feel less cramped, creating a more “kicked back” “relaxed” ride

Circular, High Arching Top Tube Frame Design

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Grips

Bicycle Weighs 38.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’4” – 6’4” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
